revision_history.reason: Pre-scoring defect found during freeze dry-run (NO search results seen): headless_benchmark.load_cases does not surface the declared metadata columns, so C2/C3/C4 could never fire. Fix: harness joins evidence_visual/evidence_ocr/evidence_asr/semantic_constraint_types/temporal_requirement from the SAME canonical CSV by query_id before classification. TRAKE rule reviewed against the corrected preview and kept verbatim-all-event-lines (bilingual VI+EN lines both retained; no editorializing). No fragment or routing change motivated by any retrieval outcome.

input_enrichment.note: Declared metadata columns are joined from the canonical CSV by query_id inside the harness because hb.load_cases drops them.

frozen_before: any Arm B (or Arm A confirmatory) scoring in this experiment
nature: Deterministic rule-based query decomposition for OFFLINE A/B measurement only. No LLM calls. No production integration. No result-dependent tuning.
allowed_inputs: original Q0 query text (case['query']; hints ignored)
declared CSV category/modality fields: task_type, temporal_requirement, semantic_constraint_types, evidence_visual, evidence_ocr, evidence_asr, scoreable, evaluation_scope, query_mode
forbidden: LLM or any model-based subquery generation
result-dependent prompt/policy tuning after seeing confirmatory outcomes
changes to retrieval/model/index/backend code or configs

complexity_classifier.purpose: Route each current-scope text query to COMPLEX (decompose) or SIMPLE (identity control) before any search call.
complexity_classifier.rule: COMPLEX iff any of C1..C4 hold; else SIMPLE.
complexity_classifier.C3: number of non-empty ';'-separated entries in semantic_constraint_types >= 5
complexity_classifier.simple_definition_note: SIMPLE = single-scene KIS-style target: task tkis, temporal_requirement in {segment, segment_start, video}, no strong OCR/ASR evidence, <= 4 declared semantic constraint types. These form the 'decomposition adds no value' control group.

general.sentence_splitting: Normalize CRLF to LF; split into lines; strip empties; within each line split on (?<=[.!?])\s+; keep order.
general.meta_sentence_drop: A sentence is META iff it ends with '?' OR (it matches ^(find|h\u00e3y t\u00ecm|t\u00ecm)\s+(the\s+)?(clip|video)\b case-insensitive AND word count <= 12). META sentences are dropped from fragments (never from the Arm A full query).
general.texty_classifier: A kept sentence is TEXTY iff it contains any digit OR contains a double-quote OR has >= 2 mid-sentence tokens starting with an uppercase letter (token regex [A-Za-z\u00c0-\u1ef9][\w\-']* ; the sentence-initial token never counts). Else VISUAL.
general.sanitization_all_fragments: Replace '/' with ' ', replace backslash with ' ', collapse all whitespace runs to single spaces, strip. Rationale: p1_q06's raw text contains '/', which would route the call to the production temporal-chain path; sanitization guarantees every fragment call uses the same similarity code path as ordinary single-query calls. Arm A always receives the RAW query verbatim (production behavior).

steps: Event fragment = each line matching ^E\s*\d+\s*[:.] case-insensitive, taken VERBATIM (label retained). Preamble/other lines are dropped.
If fewer than 2 event lines are found, fall through to generic_rule.
trake_rule.expected_effect_under_test: Per-event subqueries instead of one diluted multi-event paragraph vector (issue #59 mechanism single_vector_multi_event_no_decomposition).

steps: V = join of VISUAL sentences with single spaces; T = join of TEXTY sentences with single spaces.
If evidence_ocr == 'strong' OR evidence_asr == 'strong' OR task_type == 'qa': fragments = ([V] if V else []) + ([T] if T else []), kinds visual/text respectively.
Else: fragments = ([V] if V else []), kind visual. (Tests whether removing entity/fact clauses helps pure visual surfaces.)

Guard: if exactly one fragment was produced and its sanitized text equals the sanitized full query, mark derived='identity'; if any produced V/T fragment has < 3 words, discard fragments and fall back to identity.

simple_rule.confirmatory_behavior: IDENTITY: one fragment equal to the sanitized full Q0 text, kind 'identity', baseline routing. Arm B must therefore reproduce Arm A up to whitespace/separator normalization; deltas are expected to be exactly zero and verify the complexity gate.
simple_rule.diagnostic_behavior_predeclared: Additionally run a FORCED DECOMPOSITION via generic_rule, recorded in armB-diagnostic-simple.jsonl with status diagnostic_forced_decomposition. Excluded from all headline deltas; used only for the value/harm control report. Declared here BEFORE any scoring.

fragment_derivation.unscoreable_cases: Cases with scoreable=false (p1_q22) run Arm A and Arm B identity for latency parity only; never scored.

routing.principle: Tool-appropriate surface per fragment kind, using ONLY existing searcher parameters. All other parameters identical to Arm A in every call.

event.rationale: CLIP/SigLIP/Qwen visual surfaces only; matches declared evidence_visual strength for TRAKE events.

visual.rationale: Same as event: visual-scene fragment served to visual surfaces.

text.rationale: Baseline weights kept (no re-weighting confound); OCR/ASR sparse channels active. The visual channel also embeds this fragment because the existing API cannot suppress it; recorded as an approximation.

identity.rationale: Exact replica of the Arm A call.

fusion.score_formula: score(d) = sum over fragments of 1/(60 + rank_f(d)) where rank_f is d's 1-based position in fragment f's top-20 normalized list
fusion.dedup: by (video_id, frame_id); first occurrence (highest fused score; ties broken by earlier fragment index, then lower rank within that fragment)
fusion.scoring: Fused list scored against the ORIGINAL case ground truth via headless_benchmark.metrics_for_results (official tolerance contract, provisional tier). The original full query is preserved for final evaluation; it is never replaced in scoring.

execution_protocol.order: One discarded warmup call (first scoreable case, Arm A params). Then per query, interleaved: Arm A call(s), then Arm B confirmatory call(s), then Arm B diagnostic if pre-declared. Balances cache drift across arms.
execution_protocol.determinism_probe: After the main loop, re-run Arm A for the first two scoreable query ids and compare ranking fingerprints (video#frame sequence at depth 20) against the main-loop results; record match booleans.
execution_protocol.latency_accounting: Per-call latency_ms recorded per fragment. Arm B reports latency_ms = max(fragment latencies) (critical path) and sum_fragment_latency_ms (sequential cost). extra_calls = n_fragments - 1.

failure_taxonomy_rules_frozen.hit: first_correct_rank is not None and <= 20 under official tolerance.
on_miss_assign: knowledge_bridge_requires_llm IF 'world_knowledge_bridge' appears in semantic_constraint_types (pre-declared: rule-based policy cannot resolve knowledge clues like Spielberg-1975 -> Jaws -> shark).
correct_result_outside_top20 ALWAYS on miss (literal, mirrors issue58 convention).
additional_flags_on_miss: temporal_understanding_required IF temporal_requirement in {exact_boundary_multi_event, ordered_sequence, multi_scene_sequence, long_temporal_relation}
poor_frame_sampling IF nearest_gold_delta_seconds is not None and > 10.0
gold_video_absent_from_top20 fact recorded when no top-20 entry shares the gold video id

headline: mean_recall_at_1
mean_recall_at_5
mean_recall_at_10
mean_recall_at_20
mrr_at_20 (= mean reciprocal_rank)
no_hit_within_20_count
metrics_contract.ground_truth_tier: provisional (source_text_verified_needs_corpus_validation); absolute numbers carry this caveat

recommendation_mapping_frozen.no_benefit: Complex-group Recall@20 delta <= +0.05 AND MRR@20 delta <= +0.03, or deltas negative.
recommendation_mapping_frozen.conditional_benefit: Positive complex-group gains concentrated in a declared slice (e.g., TRAKE event coverage) without harming other slices beyond noise (-0.05 R@20 / -0.03 MRR), OR simple-control shows harm that gating avoids.
recommendation_mapping_frozen.strong_benefit: Complex-group Recall@20 delta >= +0.15 AND MRR@20 delta >= +0.08 with no simple-control harm in the gated policy.
recommendation_mapping_frozen.note: Small n (22 queries, 21 scoreable, provisional GT): any recommendation below strong_benefit cannot justify production integration without owner-side GT validation.
